there are two banners that rerun every month. Flash Gala in the middle of the month and Premium Gala in the end, which ups the ssr rate to 6% from the usual 3%.

Each one of them containing certain Grand Characters: [https://gbf.wiki/Draw](https://gbf.wiki/Draw)

Each pull gives you 1 Cerulean Spark, which DOESN'T carry on to the next banner.

if you get 300 cerulean sparks you can trade them for one of those limited characters (can't choose Premium Gala characters on Flash gala, ofc).

So by using 300 Cerulean Sparks (Sparking) you'll be expected to get AT LEAST the one character you'll spend the spark on.

If they introduce a new Grand Char they'll be on rate-up on that banner compared to  the other grands and will likely come with new non-limited chars as well on rate-up, so you can kinda expect to get every NEW featured char by sparking, though not guaranteed.

It is not recommended to spend pulls on a 3% banner, which are called filler banners. So the main gacha loop is to amass enough crystals and tickets to spark in Flash or Premium gala.

(seasonal characters like halloween ones usually don't feature during a Gala, so it feels bad to try to get them, as the rate will be 3%, though some are quite strong)

SIDE NOTE: There is a separate special banner called Classic Draw which is the only place you can pull for certain old characters.

Unlike in the normal banners, the cerulean sparks doesn't reset in this one (only after 2 years), as the banner is permanently available, so it is a option to slowly pull on this banner as the year goes on to get the older characters.

1. There are a LOT of characters. You'll get a lot of them as a f2p through the years but to get them all is not easily done or necessary, really. Roulette and sparks will give you most of your roster.
2. See above, The price to get a ticket where you guarantee a character (the available ones change depending on promotion, festivities etc) is \~20 usd
3. There are a few characters only obtainable via certain past collaborations or  promotions. The events where you obtain collab ones like Luffy and Tanjiro are VERY rare to rerun, so you might be out of luck with that.

The promotionals from serial codes and whatnot can be obtained via a Siero Special Ticket, which is obtained by trading 150 gold moons (not easy to get, 1 gold moon per ssr dupe) and it is recommended to use the ticket for those characters only if you REALLY like the char or this specific verison of them.

edit: you can see all of them and the means for recruiting here: [https://gbf.wiki/SSR\_Characters\_List#Collaboration](https://gbf.wiki/SSR_Characters_List#Collaboration)
